entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Nbo fo poorum, O nminga Winne, ti fo inge man ti nmina fom la n’puusa fo, mam sake lelewa ti manka ta panga dee Fom tari, ti man dela nasa dee Fo de tibsa. Win disere ka le bona, Fo ma, vom songra, nbo wuu.
